## Agents
URL: /ai/docker-agent/concepts/agents/
Markdown: /ai/docker-agent/concepts/agents.md
Description: Agents are the core building blocks of Docker Agent. Each agent is an AI-powered entity with a model, instructions, tools, and optional sub-agents.

Markdown: /ai/docker-agent/concepts/distribution.md

URL: /ai/docker-agent/configuration/commands/
Markdown: /ai/docker-agent/configuration/commands.md
Description: Define slash commands that send prompts, open URLs, or switch agents, and reuse them across agents with top-level command groups.

## Flavors
URL: /ai/docker-agent/configuration/flavors/
Markdown: /ai/docker-agent/configuration/flavors.md
Description: Ship one agent file with named variants, enabled at run time as YAML patches.

URL: /ai/docker-agent/configuration/hcl/
Markdown: /ai/docker-agent/configuration/hcl.md
Description: Write Docker Agent configs in HCL instead of YAML, using labeled blocks, heredocs, and the same underlying schema.

## Hooks
URL: /ai/docker-agent/configuration/hooks/
Markdown: /ai/docker-agent/configuration/hooks.md
Description: Run shell commands at various points during agent execution for deterministic control over behavior.

URL: /ai/docker-agent/configuration/models/
Markdown: /ai/docker-agent/configuration/models.md
Description: Complete reference for defining models with providers, parameters, and reasoning settings.

## User Settings
URL: /ai/docker-agent/configuration/user-settings/
Markdown: /ai/docker-agent/configuration/user-settings.md
Description: Full reference for the global settings block in ~/.config/cagent/config.yaml: theme, layout, YOLO, sound, snapshots, permissions, hooks, keybindings, and how they interact with agent config and CLI flags.

## Mastering Testcontainers Cloud by Docker：通过容器简化集成测试

URL: /guides/testcontainers-cloud/
Markdown: /guides/testcontainers-cloud.md
Description: Docker 的 Testcontainers Cloud 通过将容器管理转移到云端来简化集成测试。它能为数据库等容器化服务提供更快、更一致的测试，提升 CI/CD 流水线的性能与可扩展性，而不会给本地或 CI 资源带来压力。非常适合需要高效、可靠测试环境的开发者。

Description: Default value for global ARG results in an empty or invalid base image name

Markdown: /reference/build-checks/invalid-definition-description.md
Description: Comment for build stage or argument should follow the format: `# <arg/stage name> <description>`. If this is not intended to be a description comment, add an empty line or comment between the instruction and the comment.
